user.title: Setup Radar Hail Risk
user.description: Configure the location source, optional lightning sensors, and baseline thresholds. Leave location blank to use the Home Assistant core location. Leave both lightning fields empty for radar-only mode.

data_description.location_entity_id: Optional zone, person, or device tracker. If set, this is the single source of truth for radar center and distances.
data_description.lightning_distance_entity_id: Optional distance sensor from Blitzortung or a compatible lightning integration.
data_description.lightning_counter_entity_id: Optional counter sensor paired with the lightning distance sensor.
data_description.lightning_azimuth_entity_id: Optional azimuth/bearing sensor used to estimate strike position and correlate it with radar cores.
data_description.analysis_radius_km: Radius around the configured location for radar tile analysis.
data_description.lightning_trigger_radius_km: New lightning inside this radius can trigger or strengthen evaluation.
data_description.warning_lightning_distance_km: Lightning at or below this distance can contribute to warning level.
data_description.urgent_lightning_distance_km: Lightning at or below this distance can contribute to urgent level.
data_description.core_watch_dbz: Radar reflectivity threshold for watch-level storm cores.
data_description.core_warning_dbz: Radar reflectivity threshold for warning-level storm cores.
data_description.core_urgent_dbz: Radar reflectivity threshold for urgent-level storm cores.
data_description.min_core_pixels: Reject isolated radar pixels below this connected-core size.
data_description.min_analysis_interval_seconds: Minimum time between expensive radar analyses unless a triggering event occurs.
data_description.stale_clear_seconds: Radar or lightning data older than this is treated as stale and gated out of active classification.
data_description.rainviewer_zoom: RainViewer tile zoom. Higher zoom is more detailed but heavier.
data_description.rainviewer_frames: How many recent radar frames to inspect for current state and trend.
data_description.warning_core_distance_km: A warning-level core inside this distance can contribute to warning level.
data_description.urgent_core_distance_km: An urgent-level core inside this distance can contribute to urgent level.

error.entity_not_found: Selected entity was not found in Home Assistant.
error.invalid_value: One or more values are not valid numbers.
error.invalid_range: The value is outside the supported range.
error.invalid_threshold_order: Reflectivity thresholds must increase: watch < warning < urgent.
error.invalid_distance_order: Warning distances must be greater than or equal to urgent distances.
error.invalid_trigger_radius: Lightning trigger radius must be greater than or equal to the warning lightning distance.
error.lightning_pair_required: Select both lightning distance and lightning counter, or leave both empty for radar-only mode.
